text: Industrial and Vehicular Contributions to RSP in Outdoor Air
Institute of Hygiene and Preventive Medicine, University of Genoa.
To pursue our multi-pronged approach in supporting work on main influential factors
Dr. Izzotti has published on tobacco mutagenicity, bacterial antimutagens and is
currently working on industrial and vehicular contributions to RSP in outdoor aid. As
Genoa is an extremely polluted area - air, soil and water - considerable interest is
being paid to health effects. Though Dr. Izzotti has made unhelpful statements on
active smoking, he has shown interest in working with PM.
To be determined - initial 12 month phase anticipated to begin early 1995
